|game_text='''0 side — Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi'''

Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and a Sith's Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct. For remainder of game, you may not deploy [Episode I] Dark Jedi. Opponent loses 2 Force when a character hit by Vader's (or Galen's) Lightsaber leaves table on the same turn. While this side up, may ▲ Galen's Fighter. Galen's immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present. Flip this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

'''7 side — Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe'''

While this side up, opponent's Force drain bonuses are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds may not be canceled. During your control phase, may retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2 Force to ▲ any one card without ability. If targeting a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin's Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2. Flip this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of ability > 3 present at a battleground site or if neither Vader nor Galen is on table.
|hatnote=For the original printed text, see [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]. For the later errata text, see [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)]].

|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4)]]. The later errata version is [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published card image shows the PC-E1 text of the 0 side, so the first image is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-57-Hunt_Down_And_Destroy_The_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026); the second is the Master List slip of the 7 side ([[:File:VL-history-1240-58-back-master.png]]), which prints the same 7-side text as PC-E1. The Players Committee card image of the 0 side ([[:File:VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif]], marked E) prints a third wording: the PC-E2 text but with “May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct.” It has no page of its own; whether it records a separate printing is a question for Bill (8 November 2026). The card image of the 7 side ([[:File:VB4-D-theirfirehasgoneoutoftheuniverse-pre.gif]]) prints the PC-E1/PC-E2 text.
